description: Defines a sealed class ApiResult with subclasses Success and Error to represent operation outcomes, along with extension functions to check success or error status.

classes.name: ApiResult
classes.description: A sealed class representing the result of an API operation, parameterized by type T.

classes.name: ApiResult.Success
classes.description: A data class representing a successful API result, containing data of type T and an optional message.

classes.name: ApiResult.Error
classes.description: A data class representing an error result, containing an error message and an optional error code.

methods.name: ApiResult.isSuccess
methods.description: Extension function to determine if the ApiResult instance indicates success.

methods.name: ApiResult.isError
methods.description: Extension function to determine if the ApiResult instance indicates an error.
